answer: Locks are entered in pulse, expire in plume, and ember lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 172 aliases as a result needs 77 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4792 identities would post 571 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
